in_marathi.name: Antaryami
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Inner Ruler, Inner Master
in_marathi.long_meaning: Antaryami हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Antaryami is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'antar' meaning 'inner' and 'yami' meaning 'ruler' or 'master'. This name is given to a child who is believed to be an inner ruler or an inner master, one who has the power to control their own thoughts, emotions, and actions.
